mapper.insert: INSERT INTO disposal_request (register_id, medical_technology_id, disposal_info, disposal_position, creation_time, disposal_state) VALUES (#{registerId}, #{medicalTechnologyId}, #{disposalInfo}, #{disposalPosition}, #{creationTime}, '1')

where.if: AND c.creation_time >= CONCAT(#{creationDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND c.creation_time < DATE_ADD(#{creationDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

mapper.select:
SELECT c.*, r.case_number, r.real_name, r.gender, r.age, t.tech_name, t.tech_format, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fee_record paid WHERE paid.register_id = c.register_id AND paid.item_type = '处置' AND paid.item_id = c.id AND paid.fee_type = '收费' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fee_record refunded WHERE refunded.refund_target_id = paid.id) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS payment_ready, executor.realname AS disposal_employee_name, recorder.realname AS inputdisposal_employee_name FROM disposal_request c JOIN register r ON r.id = c.register_id JOIN medical_technology t ON t.id = c.medical_technology_id LEFT JOIN employee executor ON executor.id = c.disposal_employee_id LEFT JOIN employee recorder ON recorder.id = c.inputdisposal_employee_id
ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disposal_request c JOIN register r ON r.id = c.register_id
mapper.update: UPDATE disposal_request SET disposal_employee_id = #{employeeId}, disposal_time = NOW(), disposal_state = '2' WHERE id = #{id} AND disposal_state = '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fee_record paid WHERE paid.register_id = disposal_request.register_id AND paid.item_type = '处置' AND paid.item_id = disposal_request.id AND paid.fee_type = '收费' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fee_record refunded WHERE refunded.refund_target_id = paid.id) )
UPDATE disposal_request SET inputdisposal_employee_id = #{employeeId}, disposal_result = #{result}, disposal_remark = #{remark}, disposal_state = '3' WHERE id = #{id} AND disposal_state = '2'
